name: UnifyAir Core
what_it_is: High-performance, 3GPP standards-compliant 5G Core Network Functions implemented in Rust. Currently ships a production AMF (Access and Mobility Management Function) named Omnipath, with UPF (DataWarp) and SMF (InfiniSync) planned.
components: Omnipath (AMF - Access and Mobility Management Function) — only NF currently implemented
lightning-nf — Rust workspace crate housing NF implementations
lightning-cli — CLI entrypoint that launches NFs (e.g. `lightning-cli omnipath --config ...`)
utils — shared utilities and common code
gnbsim — gNB simulator (omecproject/gnbsim v1.6.3) used for integration tests
tshark-capturer — packet-capture sidecar used during integration tests
protocols: NGAP (N2 interface) over SCTP port 38412 — connects AMF to gNB
SBI (Service-Based Interface) over HTTP/HTTPS on port 8000 — NF-to-NF REST APIs
NAS (Non-Access Stratum) — UE authentication, registration, security mode procedures
SBI services: Namf-comm, Namf-evts, Namf-mt, Namf-loc (TS 29.518)
GTP-U (via free5gc UPF) on the user-plane N3 interface
measurement: Comprehensive structured logging via tracing (log levels: trace, debug, info, warn, error)
tshark-capturer sidecar captures all packets to /app/capture/tshark.out during integration tests
HTTP/2 decoder (sniffer/h2_decoder) decodes SBI traffic from pcap
gnbsim reports pass/fail per profile (UE registration, PDU session, etc.)
configuration: config/amfcfg.yaml — AMF: SBI bind IP/port, NGAP IP/port, PLMN, GUAMI, TAI, S-NSSAI, NAS security order (NIA2/NEA0/NEA2), NAS timers (T3502/T3512/T3513/T3522/T3550/T3555/T3560/T3565/T3570), SCTP stream counts, Tokio runtime type
config/smfcfg.yaml — SMF configuration (placeholder, NF not yet implemented)
config/upfcfg.yaml — UPF configuration (used by free5gc UPF in tests)
tests/integration/config/ — per-service YAML configs for the full integration stack
Environment variables: RUST_BACKTRACE, COLORBT_SHOW_HIDDEN, DB_URI, GIN_MODE
fault_injection: No dedicated fault-injection framework present in the repository
RUST_BACKTRACE=full + COLORBT_SHOW_HIDDEN=1 expose full panic backtraces in Omnipath container
gnbsim profiles can be tuned to exercise error paths (e.g. missing UE context, auth failures)
modes: debug — default Docker build target (omnipath-debug); includes full backtraces
release — omnipath-release Docker build target; optimised binary, AVX2 flag available but commented out
local development — run.sh rsync-to-remote workflow using sibling asn-models and open-api repos
integration test — docker-compose stack in tests/integration/ with full 5GC + gnbsim
constraints: Only AMF (Omnipath) is implemented; SMF and UPF are planned but not yet available in this repo
UPF service in docker-compose uses free5gc/upf and requires the gtp5g kernel module (noted as TODO in compose file)
All other 5GC NFs (NRF, AUSF, NSSF, PCF, SMF, UDM, UDR, CHF, NEF) are provided by free5gc v4.0.1 images — not UnifyAir implementations
Build requires Rust nightly 1.82+ and sibling repositories (asn-models, open-api) resolved via Cargo path patches over SSH
No TLS between NFs in the default test configuration (SBI scheme is http)
docker_services: omnipath — unifyair/omnipath-debug:latest, Rust AMF, ports 8000 (SBI) + 38412 (NGAP/SCTP), IP 10.0.0.2
nrf — free5gc/nrf:v4.0.1, Network Repository Function, IP 10.0.0.5
smf — free5gc/smf:v4.0.1, Session Management Function, IP 10.0.0.3
upf — free5gc/upf:v4.0.1, User Plane Function (requires gtp5g), IP 10.0.0.4
ausf — free5gc/ausf:v4.0.1, Authentication Server Function, IP 10.0.0.6
pcf — free5gc/pcf:v4.0.1, Policy Control Function, IP 10.0.0.7
nssf — free5gc/nssf:v4.0.1, Network Slice Selection Function, IP 10.0.0.8
udm — free5gc/udm:v4.0.1, Unified Data Management, IP 10.0.0.9
udr — free5gc/udr:v4.0.1, Unified Data Repository, IP 10.0.0.10
nef — free5gc/nef:latest, Network Exposure Function, IP 10.0.0.24
db — mongo:6.0.24, MongoDB on port 27017, IP 10.0.100.0
webui — free5gc/webui:v4.0.1, subscriber management UI, ports 5001/2121/2122
user-init — custom Python container that seeds subscriber data via webui REST API
gnbsim — unifyair/omecproject-gnbsim:1.6.3, gNB + UE simulator, IP 10.0.1.0
capturer — unifyair/tshark-capturer:4.4.7, packet sniffer sidecar with NET_RAW/NET_ADMIN/SYS_ADMIN caps
notable_absences: No docker-compose.yaml at repository root — integration compose is only under tests/integration/
SMF (InfiniSync) and UPF (DataWarp) Rust implementations are not present; only free5gc equivalents used
No Kubernetes / Helm charts present (cloud-native deployment listed as planned feature only)
No performance benchmarks or load-test tooling in the repository
No dedicated fault-injection or chaos-engineering tooling
